'''2018 European MPC Results Emil Wallin LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Emil Wallin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
